name: Jacqueline Ross
title: Psychologist
description: I have been providing counselling and treatment to people with a range of presenting mental health concerns for almost two decades. In that time have gained extensive experience in supporting people in returning to work after a significant mental health concern and workplace stress management. I have an interest in and have undertaken additional training in gender diversity, neurodiversity and eating disorders.
specialties: Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Chantelle Fernando
title: Psychologist
description: Chantelle has worked and volunteered in government, community health settings and counselling services for two decades. In addition to working with general mental health and relationship issues, she has extensive knowledge and experience working within the LGBTIQA+ community; health counselling - in particular sexual health and blood borne viruses; trauma & loss; emergency services support and critical incident response, and addictions counselling.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Diverse sexualities

name: Dr Lorraine Brown
title: Psychologist
description: Lorraine has been registered as a psychologist since 2001 & has a PhD in Clinical Psychology. She is a member of the APS College of Clinical Psychologists, & has clinical psychology endorsement with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency. Lorraine's main therapeutic approaches are Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), & Schema Therapy.
specialties: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Gender Dysphoria, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr Sarah Milsome
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Services listed on APS profile: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities.

name: Robyn Ming
title: Psychologist
description: Robyn Ming has extensive experience working in psychology practices across Melbourne. She is a Clinical Psychologist, experienced in the assessment and treatment of a range of mental health issues, including anxiety and mood disorders; post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD); acute stress and other adjustment disorders; alcohol and other drugs; grief and loss; borderline personality and other axis II disorders. Robyn has a particular interest in working with the LGBTQIA+ community, providing a safe, non-judgemental space to explore issues related to gender and sexuality. She has previously worked at a specialist LGBTQIA+ service and provides gender affirmative care.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Veronica Meredith
title: Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist working across private practice and public health. My experience spans across inpatient settings, community mental health, and older person's inpatient rehabilitation. and 'how did I get here'?
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Sarah Newstead
title: Psychologist
description: I am an experienced Clinical Psychologist and I have been successfully running my own private psychology practice for the past 10 years. Prior to this I worked in government run adult, child and adolescent inpatient and outpatient facilities.
specialties: Sex worker issues, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties

name: Matthew Moss
title: Clinical Psychologist
address: 1220 Nepean Highway, 322 Bluff Rd, Sandringham VIC 3191c
description: Matt works from an integrative, evidence-based framework, drawing on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), and Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT). Central to his practice is a client-centred philosophy which invites individuals to develop genuine curiosity about their own psychological experience, fostering deeper self-awareness and lasting change.
specialties: Partners/families of sex offenders, Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR
